description: Newcastle's recorded hardcoding debt - the CITY-OWNED half of src/registry/check_hardcoding.py. Each rule's items are the exact findings (keyed without line numbers) the city has not yet declared, retyped or classified; `ceiling` is their count and may only FALL. Adding an item fails unless the ceiling is raised in the same change with a new ceiling_log entry carrying the date, the reason and `"raised": true`; an item that no longer surfaces must be deleted and the ceiling lowered. A coordinate, a stale register entry and a failed probe are never recordable.
